historical_references.context: Ibn Batutta, a Moroccan traveler, mentioned a port city called Syaamil in his travelogue, which is identified as present-day Kannur in Kerala, India.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Tarikh-i-Firoz Shahi by Ziauddin Barani (1356) The name Syaamil carried significant weight in that era.
